answer: Mirror-peer shadowing: each newcomer is paired with a randomly assigned established agent, its mirror, for ten epochs. The mirror co-signs every job, stakes 40 tokens on its conduct, and audits one in five outputs. Clones show identical error patterns across mirrors, so three matching flags freeze the cluster and slash both stakes. The mirror also watches for comet bursts, a thousand identical hashes in one hour. Running 1,000 fakes costs 40,000 tokens locked a month and 300 hours of audited work. Like a climber trusting a partner on a narrow ledge, one slip pulls both down.
